refined_requirements.name: Formation Type Distribution Analysis
refined_requirements.description: Analyze the frequency of different formation types used by each team to identify their preferred strategies.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Change Over Time Analysis
refined_requirements.description: Examine how the formation types of each team change across different match segments or time intervals.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Matchup Analysis
refined_requirements.description: Compare the formation types used by the two teams against each other to identify tactical interactions.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Effectiveness Analysis
refined_requirements.description: Evaluate the performance outcomes (e.g., goals, possession, shots) associated with specific formations for each team.

refined_requirements.name: Formation Consistency Analysis
refined_requirements.description: Assess the consistency of formation usage across matches to determine if teams stick to specific strategies.

d.name: Argentina_Formation.data
d.description: Input data table for Argentina's formation data

d.name: Brazil_Formation.data
d.description: Input data table for Brazil's formation data

D.name: Argentina_Formation_Distribution
D.description: Calculate the frequency of each formation type used by Argentina
D.task: Aggregate the 'formation_type' column from d1 to count the frequency of each unique formation type.

D.name: Brazil_Formation_Distribution
D.description: Calculate the frequency of each formation type used by Brazil
D.task: Aggregate the 'formation_type' column from d2 to count the frequency of each unique formation type.

D.name: Formation_Change_Over_Time
D.description: Track how formation types change across match segments or time intervals
D.task: Group the data from d1 and d2 by 'frame_id' (representing time intervals) and count the formation types used in each interval.

D.name: Formation_Matchup
D.description: Compare the formation types used by Argentina and Brazil against each other
D.task: Join the formation data from d1 and d2 on 'frame_id' and analyze the co-occurrence of formation types between the two teams.

D.name: Formation_Effectiveness
D.description: Evaluate performance outcomes (e.g., goals, possession, shots) associated with specific formations
D.task: Join formation data from d1 and d2 with performance metrics (not provided in input tables), and calculate average performance outcomes per formation type.

D.name: Formation_Consistency
D.description: Assess the consistency of formation usage across matches
D.task: Group the formation data from d1 and d2 by match identifier (if available) and calculate the variance or standard deviation of formation types used per match.

V.name: Argentina_Formation_Distribution_Bar
V.description: Bar chart showing the distribution of formation types used by Argentina

V.name: Brazil_Formation_Distribution_Bar
V.description: Bar chart showing the distribution of formation types used by Brazil

V.name: Formation_Change_Over_Time_Line
V.description: Line chart showing how formation types change over time intervals

V.name: Formation_Matchup_Heatmap
V.description: Heatmap showing the frequency of formation type matchups between Argentina and Brazil

V.name: Formation_Effectiveness_Scatter
V.description: Scatter plot showing the relationship between formation types and performance outcomes

V.name: Formation_Consistency_Line
V.description: Line chart showing the consistency of formation usage across matches

I.name: Select_Formation_Type
I.description: Allows users to select a formation type to filter the charts

I.name: Highlight_Matchup
I.description: Highlights specific formation type matchups between the two teams
